species.name: Tuikis
species.summary: A tailed, scaled burrower: a low two-part body, four short legs, a crest, a long tail that carries the glow.

traits.name: Claws
traits.override: breeding only: the claws are how a Tuikis digs, a field ability, so they change like a doing

pending.why: no emission locus yet; until one exists every Tuikis glows gold at dusk as part of the frame

pending.trait: a glowing bulb at the tail tip
pending.why: the axial tail tapers to a point; a tip bulb is not in the catalogue

typeSpecimen.genome: every open part switch on, other open parts at the first allele of the species pool
typeSpecimen.brief: A creature with two linked tapered body regions and one smooth head, one projecting muzzle, two eyes, two pointed head projections, one smooth tapered tail and four jointed legs with rounded ends. Each body region has lagoon partially scaled skin; its smooth jointed legs have milk mint local colour fields. Each body region carries two bands.

viability.rule: random copies from the species pools at every open locus; built by the workbench resolver
